title: Be Still 30A | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Step into this stunning One Seagrove Place condo and feel like you're gliding on the Gulf! With jaw-dropping views and a beautiful makeover, this 2-bedroom, 2-bath treasure along 30A is a sight to behold!
description_expanded: Description: Be Still 30A by Royal Destinations Location: One Seagrove Place Located Gulf Front in Seagrove Beach Address: 4100 East County Highway 30A, Santa Rosa Beach Details: Step into this exquisite property and feel an immediate wave of relaxation wash over you. Leave any stress behind as you embark on a journey of rejuvenation and reflection. Take in the breathtaking views that are the stuff of dreams and the sunsets that inspire poets. This highly sought-after vista and award-winning beach offer pure serenity. Be Still 30A has been elegantly remodeled with a sophisticated coastal palette. This condo boasts luxurious decor, a well-appointed kitchen, and an open floor plan with stunning views from every vantage point. The Emerald Coast serves as the backdrop and masterpiece of this sought after destination. Choose from two king bedrooms for your sleeping accommodations, each accompanied by a full bath, with one being en-suite. For additional guests, there is a plush queen sleeper sofa in a living room designed to comfortably host. Situated along Scenic Highway 30A, One Seagrove Place is a Gulf-front condominium in Seagrove Beach. Surrounded by charming nearby communities, sublime scenery, and miles of pristine white sand beaches, it’s the perfect place for your next luxurious getaway. As the only high-rise on 30A, One Seagrove Place offers unparalleled views. Home Highlights: - Gulf Front Panoramic Views - Beach Towel Service - Air Doctor Air Purifier - Filtered Shower Heads - Slumber Pod - Graco Pack & Play - Angel Care Baby Bathtub Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 6 2 Bedrooms / 2 Full Baths / 1 Beach Shower One Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Suite with Private Bath (Shower with Filtered Shower Head), Balcony - Bedroom 2: King with Detached Bath (Shower with Filtered Shower Head/Tub Combo) - Queen Sleeper Sofa - Open Concept Design Including Living, Dining and Kitchen with Stunning Views, Laundry Community Amenities: - Community Heated Pool - Private Beach - Workout Facility - Parking - Elevators - Redfish Rentals for Bikes, Bonfires and Beach Sets (Sold Separately) Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore!
